description: List every agent name that has a mailbox here, so you know valid recipients for mail_send. Read-only: it changes nothing. Returns one line per agent: "<name> - last started <ISO time>", or "never started" for an agent that has mail waiting but has not run yet. Your own name is marked "(you)". A recent start time suggests the agent is active, but it does not guarantee a session is open right now.
name: mail_peers
title: List agents on the mailbox
